name: image-gen
description: Image generation. Local: Z-Image Turbo (Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo, Apache-2.0) through diffusers on CUDA (the PC, with CPU offload on 8 GB) or Apple MPS (the Mac); set up with tools/setup_imagegen.py. Free online: Qwen-Image 2.1 through ModelScope (set MODELSCOPE_API_KEY; about 250 a day). Online: FLUX on NVIDIA (NVIDIA_API_KEY) or Hugging Face (HF_TOKEN). LOKI's `image` specialist.
